Package de.eldoria.eldoutilities.debug

Record Class DebugReport.Section

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
de.eldoria.eldoutilities.debug.DebugReport.Section
Record Components:
name - what the viewer calls it, e.g. a file name; a / puts a config file into a folder
format - how the content is highlighted: yaml, json, properties, toml, log or text
level - the outcome of a DebugReport.Kind.CHECK
entries - the rows of a DebugReport.Kind.META section shown as a table
count - how often an exception occurred
firstSeen - the log time it first occurred
lastSeen - the log time it last occurred
chart - type, data and hints of a DebugReport.Kind.CHART
Enclosing class:
DebugReport
public static record DebugReport.Section(DebugReport.Kind kind, String name, String content, String format, HealthCheck.Level level, List<DebugReport.Entry> entries, Integer count, String firstSeen, String lastSeen, Map<String,Object> chart) extends Record
One part of a report. Everything after content is a hint for the viewer, null when it does not apply, and left out of the JSON then.
